public_rationale: On the operational reading of level 3, Project Vend supplies a counterexample: an LLM-based system took business actions over about a month using documented software tools. Its implementation does not require the proposed mathematical revolution. This contradicts the asserted necessity; it does not establish anything about machine consciousness. The conclusion depends on reading level 3 as the reported multi-day action-taking capability.
limitations: Project Vend was a company-run demonstration with substantial mistakes and human physical assistance.
It was not a formal OpenAI level-3 certification.
The absence of a new mathematical prerequisite is inferred from the documented implementation; the underlying model is proprietary.
A stronger, unspecified reliability requirement would leave the claim unresolved.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Reaching OpenAI's level 3 (agents) would require sentience dependent on entirely new forms of mathematics.

statement.excerpt: To reach level 3 (whatever “Agents, systems that can take actions” means) you’d need a level of sentience dependent on entirely new forms of mathematics.

from_speaker: Agents, systems that can take actions
you’d need a level of sentience

our_interpretation: This asserts a necessary technical prerequisite, not a forecast with a deadline.
I read level 3 operationally as a system taking actions on a user's behalf over several days.
Entirely new forms of mathematics means new mathematical foundations beyond established LLM computation and ordinary software orchestration, not every new algorithm or engineering improvement.
A documented counterexample to the mathematics requirement can contradict the combined necessity claim without proving that a system lacks subjective experience.
criteria.support_condition: A sound technical argument establishes that the specified agent capability requires sentience and that this sentience requires mathematical foundations unavailable when the claim was made.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented system performs the specified multi-day action-taking role using established LLM and software methods, without requiring the asserted new mathematical foundations.
